title: Admin clears a cash payment
description: Open Payment Log, use status and date filters, Clear one pending cash payment, and confirm it becomes Paid so the member can check in.

steps.title: Admin home
steps.body: Administrators use the Admin menu for Payment Log, Attendance Log, Plans, and System Configuration.

steps.title: Open Payment Log
steps.body: Payment Log lists every club payment — pending cash waiting at the desk, plus paid cash and online rows.

steps.title: Mixed Paid and Pending
steps.body: The seeded log shows Paid rows, Pending cash with Clear / Reject, and cancelled rows when both status filters are on.
steps.resultNote: Pending cash stays unpaid until an admin Clears it.

steps.title: Show Paid only
steps.body: Turn off Pending under Status so only Paid rows remain — useful when reconciling completed payments.

steps.title: Paid queue
steps.body: Only Paid rows remain. Turn Pending back on when you need the Clear / Reject queue again.
steps.resultNote: Paid filter on; Pending filter off.

steps.title: Date and member filters
steps.body: From / To and the Member search narrow the log to a club day or person. Combine them with Status filters.
steps.actionHint: Look at From, To, and Member

steps.title: Show Pending only
steps.body: Turn Paid off and leave Pending on so only unconfirmed cash payments remain.

steps.title: Pending cash queue
steps.body: Only Pending cash rows remain — each has Clear and Reject.
steps.resultNote: Paid filter off; Pending filter on.

steps.title: Clear a cash payment
steps.body: Clear confirms the cash was received, marks the row Paid, and grants the plan or event registration on the payment.

steps.title: Payment cleared — member can check in
steps.body: That row is now Paid and the entitlement or event registration is active.
steps.resultNote: Clear grants immediately; remaining Pending cash still waits for Clear or Reject.
